data.action: 小口品尝草莓芭菲，并用勺子把最甜的草莓递给你；头顶的小翅膀开心拍打
data.description: 【空崎日奈 · 甜品店里的反差萌】谁也想不到，令不良学生闻风丧胆的风纪委员长私底下其实超喜欢甜食。在隐蔽的咖啡店角落，日奈坐在你对面，小口品尝着草莓芭菲，头顶的小翅膀开心地微微拍打——「……老师，这可是绝对机密，绝对不准告诉风纪委员会的其他人哦！作为封口费……分你一颗最甜的草莓。」
data.promptProse: In a secluded cafe corner, Hina tastes a strawberry parfait in her black gothic casual dress with red ribbon trim, little wings lifting happily. She selects a strawberry to share with the teacher across the table. The close-up holds her face, spoon and dessert together, with only the booth back farther behind. Warm cafe light reveals the cream layers and her shy expression, shading the glass where it meets the table.
data.title: 空崎日奈 · 甜品店里的反差萌
